# NodeDots

NodeDots is a personal developer portfolio and product-builder profile focused on thoughtful web products for learning, clarity, trust, and practical user experience.

## Core Principle

Explain first, then invite action.

## Products

- VennURL: trusted link previews and safer sharing.
- Tabmeet: clearer browsing decisions and objective-based browsing.
- Accentta: speech clarity and accent coaching.

## Useful Pages

- Home: https://nodedots.com/
- X: https://x.com/nodedots
- GitHub: https://github.com/nodedots
- Telegram: https://t.me/nodedots

## Contact

Use the booking, email, and social links on the NodeDots site for collaboration, product discussions, and developer inquiries.
